description: The line plot illustrates the accuracy of different models as a function of the number of demonstrations, with the x-axis labeled "#Demonstrations" ranging from 0 to 1500 in increments of 250, and the y-axis labeled "Accuracy" ranging from 45 to 55. The plot compares three models: "Squared Exponential," "Tanh," and "LLaMA-2-chat-7B," each represented by a distinct line. The "Squared Exponential" model, shown with a solid black line and circular markers, starts at an accuracy of approximately 52.5 and increases to about 55.5, maintaining a high and relatively stable performance across all demonstration counts. The "Tanh" model, represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, begins at an accuracy of around 50.5 and remains relatively flat, fluctuating slightly but staying close to 50.5 throughout. The "LLaMA-2-chat-7B" model, depicted with a dashed pink line and circular markers, starts at an accuracy of approximately 48.5 and shows a slight increase to about 49.5, remaining the lowest-performing model across the range of demonstrations. The plot also includes a horizontal dashed pink line at an accuracy of 48.5, which appears to represent a baseline or threshold value.
